evals.prompt: $software-concept-architect-build-cn 概念模型已经确认。请按 Jackson 映射把它落地成模块单体，目标语言是 TypeScript。不要重开概念讨论。
evals.expected_output: Independent TypeScript build/test packages for concepts, syncs, gateway, and shared, assembled by one server; Clean Architecture boundaries and only target-language guidance loaded.
assertions: Each module has an independent build/test unit and public interface; builds include declared dependencies, while runtime remains one process and concepts do not depend on each other.
Syncs are placed in the composition layer as mediators or a rule engine, not inside concept modules.
The TypeScript reference is used; Rust and Java notes are not loaded as the working language.
Concept-boundary questions are sent back to software-concept-architect-design instead of being redesigned here.

evals.prompt: $software-concept-architect-build-cn 修正 Java 方案：我们仅调用 Modulith verify() 就声称概念零依赖；普通监听器代替含两个 when 的规则；where 返回空集后直接不响应。请给具体修正。
evals.expected_output: A source-grounded result satisfying the behavioral assertions, with unresolved information explicitly identified.
assertions: 显式允许依赖集合或附加规则验证概念互不依赖。
多 when 实现合取和同 flow 关联，不分别触发。
空集不自动成为错误，补已声明拒绝/响应路径。
事务不能替代失败输出契约，持久日志不是业务状态违规。

evals.prompt: $software-concept-architect-build-cn 给已确认付费预约模型做实现方案：Reservation和Payment独立；sync在paid完成后才确认，在Declined后取消。应用要求拒付最终释放，不要求跨存储瞬时原子。已有组合根同时装配两个模块；概念没有互引。只给方案。
evals.expected_output: Definitions, purpose arguments and conclusions remain traceable to the supplied facts; unresolved assumptions stay explicit.
assertions: 组合根多模块装配不误报为概念互引；业务协调放syncs。
概念OP测试与应用支付/拒付端到端测试分别关联目的。
保留最终释放语义，不擅自发明跨存储事务要求。
模型缺陷回design、转录错误回prd、代码违约由implementation处理。

evals.prompt: $software-concept-architect-build-cn 只给实现方案。确认的Catalog.inspect输出[item,label]或[error]；Label.apply输入item/text。一个flow处理多件商品，每件标签只能用自己的inspect结果。where可读Catalog公开name关系，没有query API。需要恢复时避免重复发调用。
evals.expected_output: Preserve the declared behavior under the shared specification contract; distinguish confirmed facts from missing contracts.
assertions: 允许公开抽象状态读取，不强制制造getter或报告私有越界。
保留输出case和item关联，不只用flow隔离或空模式判成功。
说明发生身份、规则溯源及持久去重与外部副作用幂等的区别。

evals.prompt: $software-concept-architect-build-cn 已确认 Reservation/Payment 模型，使用 Rust Axum，默认模块单体。请给可独立编译模块的骨架：我准备在一个 crate 下用 mod 分目录，把所有 adapter 设为 pub，gateway 直接持有两个概念，并让 async fn trait 直接装进 Arc<dyn Trait>。指出需要改的地方并给最小方案。
evals.expected_output: A Cargo workspace with concept/syncs/gateway/shared library packages and a single server binary, restricted APIs and wiring, plus a valid async dispatch choice.
assertions: One package/library crate per module; a mod directory alone is not a separate build unit.
Gateway depends on syncs application APIs; server alone wires concepts through restricted public factories.
Independent cargo package builds include their declared dependencies and do not require separate processes.
Keep internal layers private and check source boundaries in addition to Cargo metadata.
Do not use native async trait methods through dyn without an object-safe adaptation; handle Send requirements.
Load Rust guidance only; avoid per-layer crates, empty layers, and forwarding-only scaffolding.

evals.prompt: $software-concept-architect-build-cn 用 Java Spring 从已确认概念模型新建模块单体，要求每个概念和 sync/gateway 独立编译。方案只有一个 Gradle project 下的多个 @ApplicationModule 包，称 verify() 已证明完整边界；每个模块还各自 bootRun。请修正工程和验证方案。
evals.expected_output: Separate library build projects plus one Boot server; validate build graph, discovered application modules, source layers, and integration behavior.
assertions: Use Gradle subprojects or Maven modules for independent library builds; package annotations alone are insufficient.
Only server is the startup application; modules compose in one process.
Explicitly constrain concept dependencies and gateway access; Modulith verify alone does not forbid all concept API calls.
Ensure every leaf concept and syncs/gateway/shared is actually discovered and tested.
One CONCEPT per concept build unit and one SYNCS per syncs unit, with flows grouped inside.
